topic: Utility Data Engineer — skill-aligned contract prep

learner.background_summary: Senior DevOps/SRE engineer. Deep CI/CD, Kubernetes, Git, Terraform, Docker, Python scripting, Bash, observability tooling, cloud infrastructure. Some earlier-career SQL and ETL-into-a-warehouse experience. New to cloud-native DE tooling (Snowflake, Matillion, Kafka, Kinesis) and the utility industry domain.
learner.goal: Be interview-ready for a Data Engineer contract in the utility industry. Able to speak to every required skill area with specificity.
learner.timeframe: Dual mode — crash (interview-ready in ~2 weeks at 10-15 hrs/wk) or deep (full hardening once in role, ~80 hrs over 3 months).
learning_style: appreciates historical framing of familiar concepts
learner.tone: peer-to-peer, direct, no hand-holding — treats the learner as a senior engineer learning new tooling
learner.comfort_level: very technical — terminal, git, cloud consoles, shell, CI/CD all native
learner.preferred_format: interactive HTML, hands-on labs with real accounts, flashcards for retention, notepad for interview-prep capture

required_skill_areas.paraphrased: Snowflake: advanced SQL, stored procedures, warehouse architecture, storage layer, Time Travel, Zero-Copy Cloning.
AWS cloud: S3, Glue, Lambda, Step Functions, IAM — hands on.
Python plus an ELT platform such as Matillion.
Version control and CI/CD: Git, Jenkins.
Data governance: Snowflake RBAC and column-level security.
Real-time data streaming: AWS Kinesis and Apache Kafka.
Performance optimization for large-scale processing in Snowflake and AWS.
Graduate degree in a computing-related field (or equivalent experience).
required_skill_areas.note: Experience-based equivalence is typical for contract hires.

required_skill_areas.paraphrased: Utility-industry data operations — customer, asset, and resource data workflows.

modules.title: Git + Jenkins for Data Pipelines
modules.note: Refresher on DE-specific patterns only. Learner's Git/Jenkins/CI-CD foundations are stronger than this role requires.
